data.title: Modify task graph rendering to show parallel and series behaviour
data.description: When issues are meant to be executed in series (e.g Issues 7, 6 and 13 are children of the same parent Issue 5 and Issue 5 is in series execution mode), there should just be a vertical line connecting the issues together. When a line exits a node vertically at the bottom it indicates a 'series' execution, and when it exits horizontally to the right it indicates a 'parallel' execution. When a line exits a node vertically from the top it indicates parallel children and when it exits a node horizontally to the right it indicates parallel children. Update the tree rendering algorithm and tests with this connection behaviour. Note that the lanes are appropriate as is, it is just the connection layout and rendering that should be updated.
